arg.name: sensor_hostname
arg.description: Ouster OS-1 hostname or IP. Override per robot (e.g. os-<serial>.local).

arg.name: timestamp_mode
arg.description: Point cloud header stamp source. TIME_FROM_ROS_TIME stamps clouds with host ROS time so they align with the map->base_link->os_lidar TF; the driver default (TIME_FROM_INTERNAL_OSC) uses the sensor's free-running clock, which is ~1.7e9 s off ROS time and makes RViz / NDT fail the os_lidar->map lookup ('Could not transform'). Use TIME_FROM_PTP_1588 instead once a PTP grandmaster syncs the sensor.
